name: @w6w-apps/braze
description: Track user data, trigger campaigns and Canvases, send messages, and manage email subscriptions in Braze.

w6w.longDescription:
Braze is a customer engagement platform that runs cross-channel marketing automation — email, push, SMS, in-app, and Canvas multi-step journeys — off a single user profile. This app covers the operations a workflow most needs around that profile and its outbound messaging: track custom events, purchases, and attribute updates onto a user; resolve aliases and identities; export full profiles; and delete users on request.

On the sending side, it triggers API-triggered Campaign and Canvas sends against an audience filter or an explicit recipient list, and sends immediate ad-hoc messages outside of any saved campaign. It manages email subscription state directly and reads back hard bounces and unsubscribes, and it reads and writes the supporting content a campaign is built from — Content Blocks and catalogs — plus lists campaigns, Canvases, and segments for discovery.

Braze runs each customer's workspace on one of several fixed regional clusters rather than a single API host, and a REST key from one cluster is rejected by every other, so the app asks which instance a Connection is on rather than guessing.
